title: Next actual parity assignment
statement: For natural numbers $r,q$, an assignment of a sign vector of length $r$ to each of the $r^{q+1}$ groups, and a group $g$ among the $r^q$ groups, define the next actual assignment at position $j$ to be the product of the signs in the assignment of the child group indexed by $g$ and $j$.
hypotheses_covered: Assignment of a sign vector of length $r$ to each of $r^{q+1}$ groups
